First packaged release: a Windows installer for Hermes Bots.

## Install

Download **`Hermes-Bots-Setup-1.1.0.exe`** below and run it.

- **Not code-signed.** Windows SmartScreen will say "Windows protected your PC". Click **More info → Run anyway**.
- Installs per user by default (no admin) to `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Hermes Bots`; you can pick all users or another folder. Adds Start menu and Desktop shortcuts.
- Your app settings and local data stay in `%APPDATA%\Hermes Bots`, the same folder the app used when run from source, so your connection and group chat history carry over. Nothing to uninstall first.
- **Updates:** install a newer `Hermes-Bots-Setup-<version>.exe` over this one. There's no auto-update.

## What's new

- **Team awareness:** every bot knows its team, itself, its groups and the time through a team directory, and **+ → Team** shows the whole team.
- **Mid-turn messages:** a message you send while a bot is working goes into the running reply instead of starting a second one. Stop is its own button.
- **Background jobs strip:** a strip above the composer shows the helpers a bot has handed long jobs to, live, and lets you stop them.
- **Approval cards:** approve or deny a bot's risky actions right in the chat.
- **Memory:** per-bot memory you can read and edit, plus shared memory every bot knows.
- **Routines:** scheduled or one-off tasks per bot, with results in your chat.
- **Group posts from a 1:1 chat:** ask a bot to tell one of its groups something and it posts there as itself.
- **Shared folder:** one folder on the Hermes machine every bot can read and write.
- **Bots can edit their own profile** (name, label, description) when you ask.
- **Richer Markdown:** tables, task lists, syntax-highlighted code with Copy, and KaTeX math.
- **This PC actions ask first:** with Allow control on, a bot asks in the chat before each mouse or keyboard action (Allow once / Allow for this chat / Deny). Screenshots don't ask.
- **Edit a routine:** a pencil on each routine card opens the form prefilled; saving keeps where results are delivered.

## Earlier fixes included

- Windows **This PC** input bridge (mouse and keyboard control) fixed.
- Group chat fixes.
- **Max** thinking level.
- Simpler UI.
